'''Ch'been''' was a [[H'drachi]] [[spiritualist]] and [[Holodrama/Legends|holofilm]] director with a reading ability known as the "[[Time-stream|timestream]]" that would allow him to see into the future. His work included such holofilms as ''[[A Shadow Falls]]'', ''[[Tyranny Reborn]]'', and ''[[Dark Romance]]''. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he was hired as the director for a [[Untitled Baby Ludi Project|Baby Ludi holofilm]].
